memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports independent in ADLs, walks to nearby shop without assistance, uses inhaler as needed.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (recall 1, clock draw normal) – below threshold, plan for full cognitive assessment.
falls: No falls in last 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds – within normal range.
medicines: 7 regular (salbutamol MDI SOS, budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD, montelukast 10 mg HS, telmisartan 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD, furosemide 20 mg OD, sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD) – polypharmacy, request review against Beers criteria.
mood: Denies low mood or anxiety; reports good sleep.
carers: Shalini Kulkarni, spouse.
goals: "I want to stay active and keep my breathing under control so I can travel to see my grandchildren."

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Over the past week I have woken up with tight chest and needed my salbutamol inhaler three times at night. My usual walk to the market leaves me short of breath sooner than before.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Manages household chores; reports mild dyspnoea on climbing stairs, uses salbutamol 4-5 times/week.
cognition: Mini‑Cog not due; awaiting full assessment scheduled for March.
falls: One fall in last 12 months (slipped on wet bathroom floor, no injury); gait cautious; timed up‑and‑go 13 seconds – raised fall risk, advise exercise programme and supportive footwear.
medicines: 8 regular (added allopurinol 100 mg OD for uric acid) – polypharmacy, medication review against Beers criteria recommended.
mood: Reports frustration about occasional breathlessness; denies depression.
carers: Shalini Kulkarni, spouse.
goals: "I want to stay on my feet and keep walking to the temple without fear of falling."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Refer to Dr. S. Rao, Pulmonology, Vikram Hospital, for evaluation of worsening asthma symptoms and nocturnal exacerbations. Please assess inhaler technique, consider biologic therapy, and provide action plan.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Pulmonology review: Patient demonstrates good inhaler technique; asthma remains partially controlled (ACT 16). Recommended addition of low‑dose inhaled corticosteroid‑formoterol (already on budesonide-formoterol) and trial of montelukast continuation. No biologic indicated at present. Return to primary care with asthma action plan.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs; walks 30 minutes daily without dyspnoea; uses salbutamol <2 times/week.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 4/5 (recall 2, clock draw normal) – below threshold, plan for full cognitive assessment deferred to next year.
falls: No falls in last 12 months; gait smooth; timed up‑and‑go 10 seconds – normal.
medicines: 7 regular (stopped allopurinol after uric acid normalised) – polypharmacy, medication review against Beers criteria completed.
mood: Reports improved mood, enjoys gardening.
carers: Shalini Kulkarni, spouse.
goals: "I wish to keep my breathing easy and my kidneys stable so I can enjoy my retirement."
